    matchLabels:

    metadata:

    spec:
      serviceAccountName: shippingservice
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
      - name: server

          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:

              - ALL

          readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
        image: wangyl2128/shippingservice-v2:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 50051
        env:
        - name: PORT
          value: "50051"
        - name: DISABLE_PROFILER

        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          grpc:
            port: 50051
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
